newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR firmer as uncertainties persist.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR firmer as uncertainties persist.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were firmer on Monday despite the rate reduction in central bank's short-term benchmark rates, traders said.
"By and large, the market is still on a wait and see mode," a trader said. "Despite the rate cut, we won't see banks drastically cutting their rates."
She said banks will remain skittish until the foreign exchange market stabilises.
